text:
Landlord and Tenant Board - Information for parties
What to expect at your hearing
Most LTB hearings are held by video. A Notice of Hearing tells you the date, time and how to join. Before the hearing you may be offered mediation with a Board mediator; you do not have to agree to anything.
Interpreters: The LTB does not usually provide interpreters for languages other than French or English. If you want an interpreter with you at the hearing, then you are expected to arrange for someone to interpret for you.
Legal help: Tenants may be eligible for free help from a community legal clinic through Legal Aid Ontario.
This sheet is general information, not legal advice.
